title: Case in Queue | DDS Runs | Not Eligible | Customer Notified
description:
Customer files before 72 hours (similar to TC_018). System creates case, polls daily, data eventually arrives. DIFFERENCE: When DDS data arrives and processes, the result is NOT ELIGIBLE (uncontrollable cause). Validates that the Welcome Back flow correctly delivers a Not Eligible outcome � not just eligible outcomes (TC_018 tested eligible). Customer receives notification but the message is "Not Eligible" instead of "complete your claim."

DDS data: NOT available at filing. Data arrives at D+4. Expected DDS result when data arrives: Not Eligible (Code 72, uncontrollable).
